subject: Follow-up: Costing breakdown & invoice estimate for Catalyst Biotech
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: Costing breakdown & invoice estimate for Catalyst Biotech

Hi Zoe —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so I have it right and so we can iterate on the costing model: 

- Primary workload: clinical-notes summarization + entity extraction (mixed short/medium prompts).
- Expected steady-state monthly tokens: you estimated 30–40M tokens/month, with spikes up to ~70M for batch runs.
- Latency SLO: 500ms p50 for async endpoints; 800ms p95 acceptable for longer turns.
- Data classification: PHI will be segmented and routed to our private deployment (per your compliance note).
- Procurement target: procurement would like a per-1M-token target cost to evaluate against internal budgets (you mentioned ~$6k–$8k/1M tokens as a target range).

Next steps I propose:
1) I attached a first-pass invoice estimate and a unit-econ breakdown (catalyst_invoice_estimate_v1.xlsx and token_unit_econ_breakdown.pdf). Those reflect 3 model-config scenarios (hosted small LLM, hosted large LLM with KV cache, Dedicated quantized variant).
2) Please confirm the monthly token range you want modeled (I used 30M/45M/70M in the sheet) and your preferred target $/1M-tokens to prioritize options.
3) If procurement wants Net30 or a PO path, share the contact and we’ll bundle a formal quote + terms.

Quick ask: could you confirm which of the three traffic profiles below aligns with your forecast? I’ll lock the numbers and push a formal PDF invoice.
- Profile A (conservative): 30M/mo tokens — target $/1M = $8,500
- Profile B (base): 45M/mo tokens — target $/1M = $7,200
- Profile C (growth): 70M/mo tokens — target $/1M = $6,300

Link to the live pricing calculator I used (feel free to edit): https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1XcatalystPricingSheetExample/edit#gid=0

If this looks good I’ll also loop Marissa (CS lead) and Neha (solutions engineer) into procurement conversations.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0197

Attachments: catalyst_invoice_estimate_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), token_unit_econ_breakdown.pdf (summary PDF), redwood_pricing_calculator_v2.csv (raw inputs)
From: Zoe Park <zoe.park@catalystbio.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2026 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Costing breakdown & invoice estimate for Catalyst Biotech

Jonas —

Thanks for the clear recap and the attachments. I reviewed the sheet with our data science lead this morning. A few clarifications: 

- Monthly volumes: we expect steady-state 35–45M tokens/month for production inference (real-time), plus monthly batch anonymization runs that add ~20–25M tokens (so peak months could be ~65–70M).
- Target unit cost: our finance team has signaled a target in the $6,500–$7,500 per 1M tokens range to be competitive with our internal budget for ML ops.
- Model choice: for summaries we prefer a mid-sized open model if the latency/cost tradeoff is favorable; fallback to larger models for higher-quality extracts.
- Compliance: we will want proof-of-safeguards for private deployment (audit log retention, KMS integration).

Procurement: I’m looping procurement@catalystbio.com on the next email (I’ll ask them for the PO requirements and whether Net30 is acceptable).

Please proceed with revising the invoice to model 35M/60M/70M months and target per-1M tiers around $6.5k–$7.5k so finance can see scenarios. Also flag any fixed minimums for Dedicated quoting.

Best,
Zoe Park
Head of Product — NLP | Catalyst Biotech
zoe.park@catalystbio.com
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Zoe Park <zoe.park@catalystbio.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2026 11:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Costing breakdown & invoice estimate for Catalyst Biotech

Thanks Zoe — great notes and very helpful. I updated the sheet and attached a revised estimate that models the three scenarios you requested: 35M steady, 60M mixed (prod + batches), and 70M peak. Summary highlights below: 

- Hosted small LLM (cached): $7,900 / 1M tokens at 35M; economies of scale push this to $6,700 / 1M at 70M. This assumes our continuous prefix caching and moderate batching.
- Hosted large LLM (higher quality): $9,800 / 1M at 35M; $8,000 / 1M at 70M.
- Dedicated (quantized, reserved): one-time minimum reservation for target SLAs (~$60k/mo commit) with unit cost as low as $5,200 / 1M at 70M. Dedicated has added setup and minimum commit but yields the lowest unit economics for sustained volume.

I also included a short unit-econ appendix in token_unit_econ_breakdown.pdf showing CPU/GPU time assumptions, KV cache hit-rate (assumed 18% for your workload), and tokenization overhead. 

Action items I’ll take once you confirm:
- Produce a single-page formal estimate (PDF) and a redlined SOW draft for procurement.
- Run an internal engineering note on private-deploy audit guarantees (Neha to confirm KMS/HSM options and retention SLAs).
- If procurement confirms Net30 & PO path, Marissa will prepare the invoice template and terms.

Neha — can you confirm estimated cache-hit improvement thresholds and whether the Dedicated quantized path requires any additional onboarding time beyond our standard 3-week window?

Jonas
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
